ty0-p.paragraph: Pressure-treated pine privacy fences with walk and drive gates, built straight across sloped and curved lines.

ty1-p.paragraph: Black and white metal fencing for pools, front yards and brick-column runs.

ty2-p.paragraph: Low-maintenance white vinyl privacy fencing, including lattice-top styles.

ty3-p.paragraph: Galvanized and coated chain link for yards, businesses and commercial lots.

ty4-p.paragraph: Split rail for open lots, plus walk gates and drive gates built to match the fence.

ow-h.title: Call Chris, not a call center.

ow-ld.paragraph: Advanced Fence Service is Chris's fence company in Columbia. You talk to him about the job, the materials and the price, and he's who you call when it's done.

ow-p.paragraph: Wood, vinyl, metal or chain link, the work is the same: posts set solid, lines straight and gates that close the way they should.
